producer_judgment.rationale: Both are P1 Skills Objectives in Unit 3 (Numbers 0 to 10) under the same Key Unit Competence, so grain and coordinate rank (P1, rank 0) match and same-rank direction must rest on substantive content. The second SFI ('Count, read, and write, order numbers from 0 up to 10', LCs: count/read/write/order 0-10) establishes number recognition, symbol writing and ordering of the 0-10 range; the first SFI extends this to comparing two numbers less than or equal to 10 with the relational symbols <, > and =. Ordering numbers on the 0-10 range and being able to read/write them is the enabling proficiency for expressing pairwise comparisons in symbolic form, so proficiency in the second supports success in the first. The relationship rests on this specific content progression, not on the shared Unit/Topic Area ancestors or the generic '10 / numbers' token overlap.
